title: Nominal traffic: rover telemetry at five priorities; signed commands, signed telemetry and a heartbeat from Earth; PING replies

criteria.text: Every rover envelope handed to ION is received at Earth
Every Earth envelope handed to ION is received at the rover
Every received envelope is byte-identical to the envelope handed to ION (SHA-256 of all bytes, 44 header bytes)
criteria.measured: 46 of 46 received envelopes byte-identical (SHA-256 and header)

criteria.text: The rover executes (logs) each authenticated command once, in order
criteria.measured: executed: PING, SET_HEATER, DRIVE, CAPTURE_IMAGE, SET_MODE, PING, PING, PING

criteria.text: Each PING is answered and the answer reaches Earth
End-to-end latency between the 1.55 s propagation floor and 3.0 s
criteria.measured: n=46 min 1.572 s median 1.578 s max 1.618 s

criteria.text: TTL 0 envelopes are sent with the 2147483647 s no-expiry bundle lifetime
TTL 0 envelopes sent with that lifetime are delivered
Every send uses the class of service of SPEC-DIGEST 7.5 for its priority
criteria.measured: 46 of 46 sends used the 7.5 class of service

criteria.text: Every bundle source EID matches the Source ID mapping (Rover-Alpha ipn:99.1, Earth-MCC ipn:23.1)
criteria.measured: 46 of 46 with the expected bundle source EID

criteria.text: No duplicate or unknown envelope is received
criteria.measured: 46 recv records, 0 without a matching send record

criteria.text: No receiver accepts an envelope older than its TTL
criteria.measured: 39 accepted envelopes with TTL > 0; 0 older than their TTL
